site.name: FeelFrame™
site.tagline: Some feelings deserve to be seen.
site.description: Visual stories built around real emotions, milestones and human moments.

stories.title: I'm going to make myself proud.
stories.quote: I'm tired. I'm scared. But I'm still going.
stories.context: Late nights, demanding coursework and the pressure of knowing that these exams matter. I may not feel ready every day, but I'm refusing to give up.
stories.description: A cinematic portrait about quiet determination during exam season. The visual captures the moment when exhaustion exists alongside the decision to keep moving.
stories.recipe: Quiet student portrait + late-night study atmosphere + subtle signs of fatigue + hopeful cinematic light

stories.title: Nobody sees how hard I've worked.
stories.context: I've spent hours studying when nobody was watching. The pressure, tiredness and uncertainty aren't always visible to other people.
stories.description: A deeply personal visual story representing the invisible effort behind academic progress.
stories.recipe: Solitary study environment + low-key lighting + quiet expression + cinematic shadows + authentic academic details

stories.title: I'm almost there.
stories.context: The semester has been demanding, but the finish line is finally beginning to feel real.
stories.description: A hopeful visual representing the final stretch of a difficult academic season.
stories.recipe: Student leaving a long study session + warm sunset light + subtle smile + visual feeling of transition and progress

stories.title: I became the person I hoped I'd become.
stories.quote: This moment carries every version of me that came before it.
stories.context: Years of lectures, assignments, setbacks, friendships, uncertainty and growth have led to this moment.
stories.description: A refined graduation portrait focused less on the ceremony and more on the emotional meaning behind reaching the finish line.
stories.recipe: Graduation portrait + architectural environment + confident posture + restrained emotion + premium editorial composition

stories.title: I earned this version of myself.
stories.quote: The certificate is one part of the story.
stories.context: Graduation represents more than completing a course. It represents becoming more capable, independent and confident.
stories.description: A sophisticated graduation concept designed around identity, confidence and personal evolution.
stories.recipe: Modern graduate portrait + luxury editorial framing + architectural background + controlled studio-quality light

stories.title: Something new is beginning.
stories.quote: I don't know exactly what's next. And that's okay.
stories.context: A transition is happening. The old routine is ending and something unfamiliar is beginning.
stories.description: A visual metaphor for entering a new chapter without needing to know exactly where it leads.
stories.recipe: Person standing between familiar and unfamiliar spaces + atmospheric light + visual transition + subtle symbolism

stories.title: I'm building something that matters.
stories.quote: It doesn't look big yet. But I'm building.
stories.context: I'm working on my skills, ideas and future even though the results aren't always visible yet.
stories.description: A future-focused visual for the person quietly building a career, business, skill or personal legacy.
stories.recipe: Young creator at work + modern workspace + subtle technology + cinematic depth + premium editorial framing

stories.title: I'm starting again.
stories.quote: Starting over doesn't erase how far I've come.
stories.context: Things didn't go exactly as planned. Now I'm choosing to begin again with what I've learned.
stories.description: A grounded visual story about rebuilding confidence and moving forward after a difficult chapter.
stories.recipe: Solitary reflective portrait + morning light + restrained expression + visual symbolism of a fresh beginning

stories.title: I want to remember this version of me.
stories.quote: Some moments deserve to become memories.
stories.context: This is a personal moment that matters to me. I want the feeling of this period captured visually rather than simply described.
stories.description: A flexible FeelFrame concept for personal milestones, private victories and meaningful moments that don't fit into a predefined category.
stories.recipe: Personal portrait + meaningful environment + authentic details + cinematic editorial composition
